naslov: Why I always return to Vienna
povzetek: Every city has its own pace. Vienna always reminds me that distance is sometimes the best way to see more closely.
besedilo:
Every city has its own pace. Some rush ahead of you, others wait for you at the corner. Vienna does neither — it lets you stop before you even know you wanted to.

When I first visited, I was sure I would get to know it in three days. Today, after years of returning, I know that I don't know it. I know only a few tables, a few windows and a few hours of the day when the light falls just right.

> Distance is sometimes the best way to see more closely.

You cannot write in a hurry about the cities you never forget, or about the silence you sometimes need. That is why I write slowly — at a table by the window, with coffee going cold.
